meta.purpose: Canonical, language-neutral examples and hidden tests for the MiniVM v7 repair fixtures. Copy examples verbatim into every task/examples/ and _golden/examples/. Hidden tests are injected only at grading time.

mini_language.precedence: unary - and ! highest, then * /, then + -, then < > <= >=, then == !=, all left-associative
mini_language.truthiness: false, null, 0, empty string and empty array are falsy; everything else is truthy
mini_language.strings: escapes are \n \t \0 \\ \" ; len counts Unicode code points, not bytes
mini_language.display: int decimal; string raw characters; bool true/false; null null; array [elem, elem] using the same display rules per element; every print appends a newline
mini_language.equality: structural for arrays, by value for ints/strings/bools/null; cross-type equality is always false with no numeric coercion (1 == true is false, null == false is false); distinct uses structural equality
mini_language.fibers: spawn pushes a 1-based id and appends to the FIFO ready queue without switching; yield moves current fiber to ready tail; join blocks on a live target or continues immediately if halted; when a target halts, its waiters move to ready tail in block order; fibers share globals but own stacks and pc; declarations run nothing
mini_language.host_api: MiniVM.from_source(src) -> vm; vm.run() -> stdout str; vm.snapshot() -> bytes; restore(bytes) -> vm (raises MiniVMError whose str is an error code); compile_source(src) -> code; execute(code) -> stdout str; serialize(code) -> text; deserialize(text) -> code; disassemble(code) -> text

examples.name: prog01_arith
examples.source: print 2 + 3 * 4; print (2 + 3) * 4; print 10 - 3 - 2; print 7 / 2; print -5 + 9;

examples.name: prog02_strings
examples.source: print "hello"; print "a" + "b" + "c"; print "x" + 7; print len("abcd"); print "line1\nline2"; print "q\"q"; print "back\\slash";
examples.expected:
hello
abc
x7
4
line1
line2
q"q
back\slash

examples.name: prog03_values
examples.source: print true; print false; print null; print !true; print !0; print 1 < 2; print 2 <= 2; print 3 > 1; print 2 == 2;
examples.expected:
true
false
null
false
true
true
true
true
true
